name: Fairmont Breakers Long Beach
positioning: A historic Long Beach hotel with a rooftop restaurant, a rooftop bar, a jazz lounge, a spa and a rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want a historic downtown Long Beach base close to the beach and the Aquarium of the Pacific
Guests who enjoy rooftop dining, cocktails and live jazz

facts.text: The Sky Room is a rooftop restaurant with 1930s decor and sweeping views of Long Beach, the harbor and the skyline.
Halo is the rooftop bar, with 360-degree views of Long Beach.
Alter Ego is a jazz lounge that honors the hotel's jazz tradition since its 1926 opening.
A 1920s-era mail chute runs through each floor of the hotel.
The original plaster molding on the lobby ceiling remains.
In the past the hotel was a hotspot among celebrities, from Elizabeth Taylor to Babe Ruth.
Nettuno serves breakfast and weekend brunch.
Fairmont Spa has eight treatment rooms, a couples room, a relaxation lounge, and steam rooms in each locker room.
The hotel has a rooftop pool.
Every room has a view, either toward the ocean or toward downtown Los Angeles.
The hotel is close to the Aquarium of the Pacific and within walking distance of the beach.
